income.title: Competitive Income
list: Negotiable salary based on teaching capacity & certifications (IC3, MOS).

security.title: Work with Peace of Mind
list: Full social, health, and unemployment insurance according to state regulations.
Annual leave policy according to Labor law.

environment.title: Modern Environment
list: Work at the District 1 headquarters or modern Binh Phu branch.
Fully equipped with premium devices and original software.
Participate in vibrant Team Building activities.

training.desc: Learning never stops. We enhance teacher capacity according to international standards.

professional.title: Professional Workshops
professional.desc: Regular STEM, IC3, MOS teaching method training.

list: Comply with organization's regulations and policies.
Fully participate in professional meetings and company events.
Draft lesson plans and teaching plans on schedule.
Ensure discipline and a positive learning environment.
